ri.definition: ΔVmax ≥ 30 kt in 24 h (Kaplan & DeMaria 2003), 1-min sustained winds

method.flag_rule: IsolationForest outlier (contamination 0.10, fit on climatology) AND warm side (z_TCHP ≥ +1 or z_T0–100 ≥ +1)
method.pre_storm_only: profiles sampled after the storm passed their nearest track point are excluded
method.data_source: Argo GDAC via Ifremer ERDDAP (QC 1/2 only) + IBTrACS v04r01 best track

verdict.headline: No significant early signal
verdict.summary: 4 of 65 pre-storm corridor profiles flagged (6% vs 5% in climatology, binomial p = 0.3803). A first isolated flag appeared 16.3 days before RI, but the flag rate never became statistically distinguishable from climatology before RI — treated as no early signal. The fixed 50 kJ/cm² threshold is non-discriminating here: 97% of climatological profiles in this corridor already exceed it. Climatological false-alarm rate (leave-one-year-out): 5% of profiles.
